description: Feed-forward compressor and limiter with two polyphonic channels, fixed ratios and knee shapes, makeup gain and a wet-dry mix for parallel compression; every channel shares the one set of settings

params.text: Sets the attack time, 0 to 200ms; a very short attack compresses the transients as well as the body of the sound
Sets the release time, 0 to 2 seconds
Sets the level above which the signal is compressed, in dB with 0dB at 10V; the lower it goes the more compression there is
Picks the compression ratio and knee: Limit is an infinite ratio hard knee, then 2:1, 4:1, 8:1 and 20:1, each with a soft-knee and a hard-knee setting; a soft knee eases the way into compression
Adds makeup gain to the output, 0 to 40dB, to bring the level back up after compression has pulled it down
Bypasses the compressor, connecting each input straight to the output beside it, for comparing the compressed and uncompressed sound
Blends the compressed signal with the untouched one, 0 to 100% wet, which is how parallel compression is set up

inputs.text: The audio into one of the two compressors, monophonic or up to 16 channels; the cable patched here sets that channel's polyphony

outputs.text: The compressed audio from that side, with the same number of channels as the input feeding it

notes: the meter shows gain reduction two decibels a segment, so a full meter is at least 16dB of reduction
the Thresh knob comes up at the top of its travel, at 10V, so nothing is compressed until it is turned down
